entries.name: JUDGEME_SHOP_DOMAIN
entries.description: The shop's domain in Judge.me, such as example.myshopify.com.
howToGet: In Judge.me, open Settings > Integrations and select View API tokens; the shop domain is shown beside the tokens.

entries.name: JUDGEME_API_TOKEN
entries.description: A Judge.me token for reading the shop's reviews: best an OAuth token granted only read_reviews, otherwise the private API token, which can also post and hide reviews. The connector only ever lists reviews. It goes only to Judge.me.
howToGet: Preferred: register a Judge.me OAuth app, ask the shop for the read_reviews scope only, and use the access token it returns.
Otherwise: in Settings > Integrations > View API tokens, copy the private API token. Judge.me can't regenerate it from the admin, so it is replaced through Judge.me support.
Copy it straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.
